performance.environment: Windows x64, Edge 153.0.4234.48 headless, Intel UHD through ANGLE/D3D11
performance.procedure: Three fresh processes per viewport, HTTP cache disabled, no network or CPU throttling, 30 mouse-wheel increments with rAF timestamps. Camera and renderer datasets recorded separately.
limitations: Responsive viewport emulation is not mobile hardware testing
rAF cadence does not prove every frame was presented
renderer.render CPU duration is not GPU execution time
Shader precision warnings were observed on this Intel driver without a visible scene failure
performance.applicability: Frontend source and generated production asset hashes match the restored 6fd63e0 frontend. These are retained measurements of 1855493, not a new benchmark of 6fd63e0.

corePreview.captureMethod: Two actual viewport recordings aligned using a shared clock marker before the kept footage. No retiming of the task update.
corePreview.review: Technical inspection of one frame per second throughout and every frame of the sync transition. No continuous human audiovisual review.
